subject: adult male boxer, bare torso, red boxing gloves held up in guard, red shorts, dark boxing boots
motion: a quick straight jab with the lead hand, returning to guard
facing: in a three-quarter fighting view facing screen-right

plan.pose: 3/4 facing right. Anticipation: torso leans slightly back, weight to rear (right) leg; hips/shoulders coil. Lead (left) glove draws a bit back near ribs; rear (right) glove tight at cheek. Head level, chin tucked. Left foot light on ball, heel up; right foot planted under hip, knees soft.

3/4 facing right. Key jab: torso snaps forward with hip/shoulder rotation; weight drives to lead. Left arm fully extended straight to screen-right, fist vertical, shoulder raised. Right glove tight at jaw. Head slightly down. Left foot firmly planted; right heel lifted on ball behind; knees engaged.

3/4 facing right. Follow-through: torso a hair past forward then beginning to pull back; weight easing off lead. Left fist retracts to midway, elbow bending in-line. Right glove steady at guard. Head tracking target. Left foot planted; right on ball, heel high, stance springy; knees compressing.

3/4 facing right. Recovery: torso settles toward neutral with slight backward lean; weight re-centers. Left glove back near cheek in guard, elbow in. Right glove at jaw. Head upright, chin tucked. Left foot planted; right heel lowering toward floor, both feet grounded, knees easing to flow into rest.
